hero.sub: Squeege ’n’ Shine brings the squeegee and the sparkle to homes, offices and shopfronts across Bentleigh and surrounds — inside, outside, frames, tracks and all.
hero.formTitle: Quick quote — we’ll get back to you

services.d: Inside and out — glass, frames, sills and tracks for homes of every size.
services.more: Every pane you can see, and the bits you can’t. We clean glass, frames, sills and tracks inside and out, work room by room with drop sheets and shoe covers, and check each window in the light before we pack up.
inc: Final streak check in natural light
services.ideal: Single and double-storey homes, units and townhouses.

services.d: Offices, shopfronts and strata on regular rounds that keep glass gleaming.
services.more: Clean glass is the first thing customers and clients notice. We run regular rounds for offices, shopfronts and strata, scheduled before opening or after hours so your business isn’t disrupted.
inc: Post-construction glass cleans for new builds
services.ideal: Retail strips, offices, medical suites, strata and new commercial builds.

services.d: Water-fed poles for upper floors, safely from the ground.
services.more: Upper-floor windows cleaned safely from the ground with a water-fed pole and purified water, which dries spot-free with no detergent residue. No ladders leaning on your gutters, no footprints through the house.
services.ideal: Double-storey homes, townhouses and low-rise commercial buildings.

services.d: Screens washed, tracks vacuumed and wiped.
services.more: Dusty screens and gritty tracks undo a good window clean. We take screens out where possible, wash them by hand and clear the tracks so windows and doors slide freely again.
inc: Easy add-on to any window clean
services.ideal: Homes after winter, pollen season, or before selling or leasing.

services.d: Clear gutters and clean panels for better output.
services.more: Dirty solar panels lose output, and blocked gutters overflow in the first big storm. We wash panels gently with soft brushes and purified water, and clear gutters by hand.
inc: Solar panels washed with purified water
services.ideal: Homes with solar, or overhanging trees.

services.d: Balustrades, shower screens, mirrors and glass doors.
services.more: Pool fencing, balustrades, shower screens and mirrors get just as grubby as the windows. We bring them up streak-free and treat hard-water marks where we can.

faq.q: Do you offer a seniors discount?
faq.a: Yes. Seniors Card and Carer Card holders get 15% off internal and external cleans, or 20% off external-only cleans.

faq.q: Do I need to be home?
faq.a: Not for exterior-only cleans. For inside work we’ll book a time that suits you.
Light rain is fine with our pure-water system. In heavy weather we’ll reschedule at no cost.
Bentleigh, McKinnon, Moorabbin, Brighton East, Ormond, Carnegie and nearby Glen Eira suburbs.

faq.q: How often should windows be cleaned?
faq.a: Most homes go every three to six months; shopfronts weekly or fortnightly.
